weapons.name: CDX-MC Kraken .300 PRC
weapons.source_note: Cadex product page, .300 PRC barrel option: "300 PRC | 26\" Bartlein Barrel | 1:8\" Twist | 5/8\"-24 TPI | MX1 muzzle brake". States the .300 PRC configuration of the CDX-MC Kraken uses a 26 inch (660.4 mm) Bartlein barrel with 1 turn in 8 inches twist = 203.2 mm per turn.

weapons.name: CM901 modular carbine, 7.62mm, interchangeable barrel system
weapons.source_note: Colt CM901 specifications table: "barrel length 16.1 in. (40.89 cm) rate of fire SEMI rifling 1/12 RH effective range 700 m". States a right-hand 1 turn in 12 inches twist = 304.8 mm per turn for the 16.1 inch 7.62x51mm barrel.

weapons.name: M1911A1 Pistol
weapons.source_note: TM 9-1005-211-12, pistol characteristics table: "Number of lands and grooves 6" and "Rifling, left hand, one turn in 16 in." States a six-groove LEFT-hand 1 turn in 16 inches twist = 406.4 mm per turn.

weapons.name: DD5 SBR
weapons.source_note: Daniel Defense DD5 SBR materials and construction: "BARREL: DD Proprietary Steel, Cold Hammer Forged, 1:10\u201d Twist, 12.5\u2033 S2W Profile, Mid-length Gas System, Chrome Lined". States a 1 turn in 10 inches twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: DD5 V4 Rifle
weapons.source_note: Daniel Defense DD5 V4 (7.62 x 51mm) materials and construction: "BARREL: DD Proprietary Steel, Cold Hammer Forged, 1:8\" (6.5 Creedmoor), 1:10\" (7.62), 18\u2033 S2W Profile, Rifle Length, Chrome Lined". States the 7.62 configuration uses 1 turn in 10 inches twist = 254.0 mm per turn. The 6.5 Creedmoor configuration is 1:8.

weapons.name: DDM4 PDW SBR
weapons.source_note: Daniel Defense DDM4 PDW features: "Ultra-compact platform with 7 inch, 1:7 twist barrel for compatibility with subsonic and supersonic loads" and "BARREL: Chrome Moly Vanadium Steel, Cold Hammer Forged, 1:7 Twist, 7\" S2W Profile". States a 1 turn in 7 inches twist = 177.8 mm per turn.
